floater.string: Charis Viewer is free software under the GNU Lesser General Public License, version 2.1 (LGPL 2.1). Its source code is published on the Charis Viewer download page. The licenses of the libraries it includes are in licenses.txt and licenses-charis.txt in the viewer's folder.

panel.label: Credits
panel.name: credits_panel
panel.text: Charis Viewer is made by its volunteer developers, with code, icons and data from: Firestorm Viewer (The Phoenix Firestorm Project), Black Dragon Viewer (NiranV Dean), Intel XeGTAO, AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 1.0, Stellarium (the constellation pictures and data), Lucide icons, and the others listed in licenses-charis.txt.
